[모멘텀 지표]

[지지·저항 구조]

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 방향성 부재
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.64배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 0.15 지지 확인 시 매수, 0.18 저항 돌파 시 추가 매수 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.15) vs SMA5 ($0.15)/SMA20 ($0.16)/SMA50 ($0.19): below short/mid-term trends, below long-term trends
· Position vs SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.20): below long-term trends, bearish pressure
· 52-week position (4.9%) + near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (26.6→37.3) + exiting oversold, entering neutral zone + weak upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0009→0.0013) + slight improvement + weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $0.16) + band width 32.95% suggests potential volatility expansion
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.15) + based on current price, Pivot S1 ($0.13)
· Swing resistance ($0.18) + breakout could signal mid-term trend change
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.64x) + reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + consider buying on confirmation of $0.15 support, further buying on breakout above $0.18 resistance
